name: Fredrinn
story: A master treasure appraiser in Los Pecados accumulating wealth and searching for his lost friend.

skills.name: Crystalline Armor
skills.desc: Fredrinn gains 1 Combo Point that lasts 5s each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 Combo Points. His Ultimates cost different numbers of Combo Points. Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as Crystal Energy, which decays after 5s at a rate of 10% Max HP per second. Fredrinn can convert the stored Crystal Energy into HP by 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a Combo Point resets the decaying timer.

skills.name: Piercing Strike
skills.desc: Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the target direction, dealing 125 (+7% Total HP) (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. His next Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 85 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.

skills.name: Brave Assault
skills.desc: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing 140 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first non-minion enemy hit. His next Basic Attack knocks the target airborne for 0.3s.

skills.name: Energy Eruption
skills.desc: Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1s. Hitting a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 Physical & Magic Defense for 3s and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Brave Assault by 75%. This skill costs 1 Combo Point.

skills.name: Appraiser's Wrath
skills.desc: Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his Crystal Energy as Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion ratio based on damage dealt to enemy heroes from stored Crystal Energy to HP. This skill costs 3 Combo Points.
